package.name: autokart_system_monitor
package.description: Health and startup-evidence reporting node. REPORTS only -- no safety authority, cannot gate or authorize anything (contrast with autokart_safety). Tracks ROS node heartbeat/ liveness (dynamic, graceful if a dependency is not running) and optional CPU/RAM via psutil (never hard-required). Standalone, portable node from the autokart_ros_nodes library.
